dct_description_sm:
Web app showing locations of distributors participating in the Naloxone Take Home Program in Manitoba.  
  
  This web app shows the locations of distributors participating in the Naloxone Take Home Program in Manitoba. Naloxone is a drug that temporarily reverses overdose (toxicity) caused by opioid drugs (such as fentanyl, heroin, morphine, hydromorphone). Free take-home naloxone kits are available to members of the public who are at risk of opioid overdose (toxicity), and family or friends who may witness opioid toxicity. For more information see Manitoba Health. This app uses the point feature layer Naloxone Distributors Take Home Program and the Naloxone Distributors Map - Take Home Program.
